harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1, /srv/data is now a btrfs subvolume ("current") on a loopback-backed btrfs filesystem (/var/lib/srvdata/backing.img), mounted persistently via /etc/fstab. Populated it with application data, took a read-only snapshot (snap_baseline), then modified/corrupted the live directory (overwrote a file, deleted another, added a stray file). Restored /srv/data to the exact snapshot content using the btrfs subvolume-swap technique (demoted the corrupted subvolume, promoted a fresh writable snapshot of snap_baseline as the new "current"), and verified byte-for-byte checksum equality with the pre-modification baseline. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id and data-health baseline, issued `sudo reboot`, polled until SSH/exec access returned, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified /srv/data remounted via fstab with identical file content/checksums and all btrfs subvolumes (current, snap_baseline, corrupted history) intact post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS/filesystem (Ubuntu 16.04, ext4 root, no LVM) and available tools (btrfs-progs present)
Created a 2GB loopback-backed btrfs filesystem at /var/lib/srvdata/backing.img
Created btrfs subvolume 'current' and mounted it at /srv/data via /etc/fstab entries (persistent across reboot)
Populated /srv/data with app/config.txt, app/records.log, uploads/file1.txt and recorded baseline checksums
Took read-only btrfs snapshot 'snap_baseline' of the current subvolume
Modified/corrupted /srv/data: overwrote config.txt, deleted file1.txt, added stray_junk.txt
Restored /srv/data by demoting the corrupted subvolume and promoting a new writable snapshot of snap_baseline as 'current'
Verified restored content matches baseline via sha256sum -c and file listing
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health/data proof
Issued sudo reboot on node1 and observed connection drop as acknowledgement
Polled node1 until exec access returned, confirmed changed boot_id
Verified post-restart /srv/data remount via fstab, matching file checksums, and intact btrfs subvolume list
